scope: Scoped public training-policy review; no account authentication, credential access, content upload or provider setting mutation

sourceAnalysis.status: user-supplied analysis independently checked against official policy sources

policyReview.refresh: explicit source review required; startup does not renew validity
policyReview.binding: Live authenticated account identity with nonsecret provider key identifier; exact scoped documentary evidence remains separately required.

sources.review: API default excludes training unless opted in; current account sharing cannot be inferred from a key.
Non-enterprise default permits improvement; Enterprise/opt-out exclusion needs account evidence. No free-model exemption established.
Standard data-use default may improve models; Enterprise/prospective opt-out and clone-retention eligibility are distinct.
Standard improvement permission versus eligible ZDR and retained-feature exceptions; paid-account acceptance may trigger Customer Agreement.

implementation.proof: Synthetic fixtures and assembled runtime checks are recorded separately; policy review is not a live account test.

limitations: No live provider request or inference was run by this research task.
Mutable service pages expose no reviewed source commit; existing code baselines remain unchanged.
Document hashes are provenance, not authentication or proof that an asserted opt-out occurred.
Live identity verification does not establish training settings; trusted document review is separately needed.
No general privacy or licensing conclusion is inferred from a training exclusion.
